arguments.prompt:
Create ORIGINAL purpose-drawn high-detail PIXEL ART game sprite animation on a truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No floor, no shadow disc, no checkerboard, no lettering, no labels, no panels or cell lines. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS. Every cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body figure (with complete held equipment). Side/three-quarter view facing RIGHT consistently. Natural anatomy, readable hands, constant costume and body proportions. Each pose genuinely different, not repeated or mirrored copies. Every cell independently has at least12% clear transparent padding above head, below SHOE SOLES and around hands/weapon/effects. Keep last-row feet well ABOVE the canvas edge: all toes, soles, robe and coat tails entirely visible. Nothing crosses cell or row seams. Never zoom a crouching pose up to standing height; keep the same anatomical size across the source. Small spell flashes remain local; large runtime projectiles must not be drawn as separate distant objects in these actor cells. Reference is the already generated and reviewed character presentation atlas. Preserve its chosen costume, weapon and anatomical identity; draw genuinely new ordinary movement poses, never copy a presentation row as a running animation.
SQUARE ATLAS EXACTLY4 columns by4 rows,16 complete genuinely new poses, not reused presentation poses.
IDENTITY/VERSION: Buffy Summers, adult Slayer in season7 (2002–2003). Shoulder-length straight blonde hair, plain black sleeveless tank top, burgundy/maroon fitted full-length trousers, black shoes. Natural sharpened WOODEN STAKE in anatomical right hand only when preparing/attacking; small stake holster at right waist when hands free. No Scythe, no red amulet, no firearm or magic. Same mature natural proportions as reference, not chibi.
Four rows in this exact order: idle: breath/weight shift with stake lowered; run: four actual running strides facing right, stake secured at right waist; attack: draw right-hand wooden stake, guarded short thrust, withdrawal, lowered guard; hit: surprised torso recoil, defensive crouch, recover balance, ready stance. No unseen attacker or injury.
All4 rows must contain4 complete distinct full-body poses. Feet/soles especially in last row have clear transparent padding and are not cut. No new powers, no extra objects.
